home.heroTitle: Carved from the olive trees of the Holy Land
home.heroText: Nativity sets, crosses, rosaries and pieces for the home, each one shaped by hand from olive wood.
home.heroAlt: The Gethsemane emblem: an arch formed by an olive branch
home.value1Text: Every piece is cut, carved and polished by hand, so no two are exactly alike.
home.value2Text: The wood comes from pruned branches of olive trees, a tree that lives for centuries.
home.value3Text: Olive wood is dense and hard-wearing, with a warm grain that deepens over the years.
home.storyTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.storyText: Olive wood carving has been practised in and around Bethlehem for centuries. We work with carvers who keep that tradition alive.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Our name comes from Gethsemane, the olive garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem; the word means “oil press”. Every piece we offer begins as a branch of an olive tree in and around Bethlehem.
about.p1: Olive trees here can live for hundreds of years. Carvers use wood from branches cut during pruning, and dry it slowly before it reaches the workbench.
about.p2: Bethlehem’s carving families have worked olive wood for generations. Each piece is cut, carved, sanded and polished by hand, so the grain, colour and size vary a little from one piece to the next.
about.p3: We are a small shop, and we would rather tell you plainly what you are buying than promise too much. If you have a question about a piece, write to us on WhatsApp and we will answer honestly.
about.sister: Gethsemane is the sister store of <link>holylandtimber.com</link>.
